source: PRD FR-42 and §8 rules E01-E03. Field paths are prototype placeholders because the PRD §19 Q13 says the official EoA and Format-2/3 field schemas are not confirmed. md/rules.json marks RULE-E01, RULE-E02 and RULE-E03 blocked pending official source mapping.
normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold and collapse whitespace; punctuation and token order remain significant.
human_review: Required. A mismatch is a discrepancy signal only; it is never a formal deficiency, workflow gate, approval or rejection.

rules.title: Trust/Society/Company name on NOC compared with EoA
NOC old address and survey number compared with EoA
Institution name, PID and type compared across documents

note: No field path is treated as an official template or rule interpretation. Missing values and unverified values remain review-required; no result is activated in the approved compliance rule set.
